title: Marie Kruses Skole
description: mks.dk Marie Kruses Skole is a private school in Farum, Denmark, founded in 1869 by education pioneer Marie Kruse, offering a full track from kindergarten through gymnasium STX to about 1100 students. It is the only free primary school and the only gymnasium in Furesø Kommune, employing 107 people and led by rektor Carsten Gade. The school runs 8 gymnasium study lines including Biotek, Mat-Fys, sports, business, super languages and music, plus unique programs like Kruse Elitesport and diving. Revenue in 2024 reached 109.5 million Danish kroner with a 1.4 million profit, backed by 68 percent state subsidy and a stable surplus for 5 straight years. Tuition is 2190 kroner per month with financial aid available, and it attracts over 1100 students on its waiting list. Its key strengths are 157 years of heritage, top national exam results and free admissions independent of municipal student distribution rules.
